description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
